0x000828.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000921.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x00099B.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B4B.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B86.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000BDA.en: 「Botched it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D2B.en: 「So this is it... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000DD7.en: 「No good, I took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E24.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E62.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F54.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010FD.en: 「Damn it! All hands, abandon ship, now!!」

0x001144.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001236.en: 「Ngh... You're good, I'll give you that.」

0x001265.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012B3.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x00136E.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00139D.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013DB.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00140A.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00145D.en: 「Damn it all... I have to withdraw.」

0x001495.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll fall back for now...!」

0x0015FB.en: 「Ejecting, I am...@ Ngh...! Can't even bow out gracefully...」

0x0016B9.en: 「Guaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001966.en: 「Captain, we've placed Axel Almer in the brig.」

0x0019D4.en: 「Surprisingly, he came quietly.@ He's an enemy we've traded lives with more than once, but...@ he seems less on edge than before.」

0x001A9B.en: 「By the way, still no contact@ with the Moon or the colonies?」

0x001B08.en: 「And the flashes on the lunar surface?」

0x001B31.en: 「Two, about forty minutes ago, over the Sea of Nectar...@ Nothing confirmed since.」

0x001B93.en: 「Hmm...@ I'd rather not believe the outcome's already decided, but...」

0x001BE6.en: 「Contact on radar!@ Multiple high-heat sources, one o'clock, elevation 15, range 6!@ Heading for the Moon!」

0x001CA7.en: 「Then it's the Guests or the Ruina...!@ Pursue at once! All hands, battle stations!@ Ahead full, both engines!」

0x001D3A.en: 「Enemy mobile weapons deploying across our course!@ Enemy vessel is accelerating!」

0x001D9C.en: 「Don't let them reach the Moon! Ready anti-ship combat!」

0x001DD9.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units!@ The battleship is top priority!@ Don't let it slip out of the combat zone!」

0x001E4B.en: 「Enemy vessel is breaking off from the combat zone!」

0x001EA7.en: 「High-heat source group closing fast!@ Straight in from ten o'clock, depression 20!」

0x001F2B.en: 「Yes! But one of them has no matching data!」

0x001F6E.en: 「Oh my. Here I thought I was just stuck on hold-up duty, and@ look what a big catch I've reeled in.」

0x001FDF.en: 「That machine...@ from its shape and movement, I'd guess it's built for high-speed combat.」

0x002038.en: 「Yeah, looks like the one@ the Inspector Aguiile piloted.」

0x002094.en: 「If it isn't a mass-production type,@ there's a good chance an enemy commander@ is aboard.」

0x002106.en: 「We're on an expedition, so losing our ride would be a problem.@ But I suppose that's true for you too.」

0x0021B2.en: 「Anti-air defense! Don't let it get close!」

0x0021E3.en: 「Anyone near the Hagane, give her cover!」

0x002217.en: 「Captain! On Deck 5, the Vaisaga is@ moving into launch position!」

0x0022B1.en: 「Axel Almer! Why are you there!?@ No, how in the world did you...!?」

0x002325.en: 「My skill at breaking out went up on 'the other side.'@ Like so.」

0x00237B.en: 「Trying to make a break for it, are you!?」

0x0023A3.en: 「I've no intention of dying in a coffin.@ Now hurry up and open the hatch.」

0x00241B.en: 「Or would you rather I break my way out?」

0x002446.en: 「Ngh... We've no choice. Open the hatch!」

0x002483.en: 「My, is a single machine all the backup you've got?」

0x0024C0.en: 「...Keeping Lamia Loveless's settings.@ DFS, semi-adjust. Motion data,@ RT arrange. Contact.」

0x0025A5.en: 「I told you, I don't intend to die in a coffin.@ I can't afford to lose ground here, either.@ Especially now, with no way back to Earth.」

0x00266C.en: 「You lot, hurry up and sink that ship.@ I'll deal with the new face.」

0x0026F3.en: 「I don't take orders. I'll do as I please.」

0x002758.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units.@ Leave the Vaisaga's <IFF> tagged as friendly.」

0x0027BC.en: 「Understood.@ Captain Axel, the Vaisaga still has my settings...」

0x002812.en: 「You think there's something you can handle that I can't?@ Besides, this was <Shadow-Mirror> tech to begin with.@ No problem at all.」

0x002908.en: 「Cover the Vaisaga!@ AAW auto, commence firing!」

0x00295E.en: 「...That took the wind out of my sails a bit.@ No more solo charges, then.」

0x0029C9.en: 「...Seems like quite the confident one.@ I don't dislike that type.」

0x002A2B.en: 「I once tried to team up with your predecessor, but...@ in the end we were just too incompatible, the two of us!」

0x002AB4.en: 「Ngh, every Zeranio sunk@ in this little time...@ You're better than I thought, Steel Dragon Squadron!」

0x002B47.en: 「Now I can't afford to back down either!」

0x002B90.en: 「To think they'd give me this much trouble...!@ No wonder Wendro and the others lost.」

0x002BFE.en: 「But you know, we're not like them!」

0x002C38.en: 「Enemy machine closing! Straight in from one o'clock, elevation 80!@ One unit, entering range 3!」

0x002D3F.en: 「If so, that's a quick payback visit.@ And with just a single machine, no less.」

0x002DC3.en: 「The situation's against us. Fall back, Seti.」

0x002E35.en: 「Th-then the reinforcements the commander mentioned,@ that was you!?」

0x002EA7.en: 「Why didn't you contact me first... no, forget that!@ Why did you just vanish without a word!?」

0x002F40.en: 「What is it?@ Are you here to help, or to hold the rear... which is it?」

0x002FAF.en: 「More to the point, turning this around against them@ won't be easy. I'll secure the retreat.@ Pull back.」

0x003030.en: 「If I go out there and it ends up like this,@ I can't face Commander Zezernan...!」

0x0030AA.en: 「I can't afford to lose you here,@ our human commander.」

0x00312E.en: 「It's also... a request of my own.」

0x003190.en: 「Enemy machines have retreated!@ No sign of anything following!」

0x0031DD.en: 「So that commander machine came to fetch the high-speed type...」

0x003226.en: 「Good instinct for when to pull out. But reckless.」

0x003251.en: 「Captain, you're not exactly one to talk@ about other people, ya know.」

0x0032AD.en: 「...Which is it?@ That odd way of speaking hasn't changed.@ Nostalgic, in more ways than one.」

0x003351.en: 「No. We'll regroup before entering lunar waters.」

0x0033AD.en: 「Maintain full perimeter alert. Bring all units home!」

0x0033FA.en: 「What difference does one more machine make, I wonder?」

0x003443.en: 「A comeback... no, just sore losers, more like.@ But this world is harsh on newcomers!」

0x0034BD.en: 「Think you can keep up@ with my Beaudrifer?」

0x00350A.en: 「That machine... whoever's aboard@ might be a strong-willed woman, like Aguiile.」

0x0035AA.en: 「Our interests just happened to align.@ I haven't forgotten the past,@ and I don't intend to beg forgiveness.」

0x003634.en: 「Nor do I mean to hold this over you.@ The Shadow-Mirror was wiped out@ by your hands, after all.」

0x0036C2.en: 「You... why didn't you just run while you had the chance?」

0x003705.en: 「If there'd been anywhere to run, I would have.」

0x00375B.en: 「No. I just thought I'd watch you all struggle.」

0x0037C9.en: 「Captain Axel...@　will you fight alongside us?」

0x00381C.en: 「I'm here to take back the Soulgain on Earth.@ Don't expect me to play nice with you.」

0x00388D.en: 「...There's no pay in it.@　And expect your movements aboard ship to be restricted.」

0x0038EF.en: 「Do as you like.@　Once my business is done, I'll be gone.」

0x00393C.en: 「...Are you sure about this, Major Kai?」

0x00396D.en: 「Right now I'll take any firepower I can get.@　I'll square it with the captain.」

0x0039E6.en: 「...A rather late report of arrival,@　Grofis Lacrein.」

0x003A5B.en: 「And to think you failed to seize Heaven's Gate...」

0x003AA4.en: 「Commander, the Aaan-known moved so faaast,@　there wasn't much I could dooo.」

0x003B09.en: 「I've had reports that they deliberately changed@　their warp emergence point@　to fight the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x003B84.en: 「Eeeither way, we needed to staaall them, riiight?」

0x003BC4.en: 「Besides, if Roff hadn't come for me, I'd have...」

0x003C07.en: 「Enough.@　Chafrois, you are to continue the lunar@　conquest operation. Secure the Moon Cradle without fail.」

0x003CB6.en: 「Lacrein, I'll give you one more chance.@　Retake Heaven's Gate together with Forschwa.@　That is all.」

0x003D5C.en: 「...Commander, I was suuure the reinforcements@　would be regular army, so why Roff?@　And him, a mercenary? Thaaat's news to me.」

0x003E10.en: 「I don't know how he came to be a mercenary.@　Golakunul referred him.」

0x003E69.en: （Golakunul... the war merchant the commander's cozy with.@　So thaaat's the line of work Roff got into...）

0x003EF8.en: （And the reeeason the regular army didn't come...@　maybe it's tied to the Privy Council afteeer all.）
